title: Noob
body:
Description

Noob is an NPC who trades Steel Axes and Steel Pickaxes for their classic variants, the Classic Axe and Classic Pickaxe. Prior to the second anniversary update (1.74.0) in January of 2025, he did not exist.

Appearance

Noob sports yellow skin, a blue torso, and legs - the traditional appearance of a classic Roblox Noob.

Dialogue

"Wanna be friends?" - interaction prompt

When no tool is placed in front of him:

  • "Hello! Bring me a Steel Axe or Steel Pickaxe, place it before me, and I will retroify it!"
    • Got it! (Ends conversation)

When you bring him a Steel Axe or Steel Pickaxe:

  • "Thank you for bringing me this amazing tool. I will eat the soul of it's futuristic capabilities, giving you this POOR, USELESS, RETRO AXE... you FOOL!!!"
    • Thanks.....! (Ends conversation)
